description: Canonical human-edited registry for public-safe performance surface and component identity. Generated browser, Worker, and operator projections must never be edited as inventories.

browser.rule: Emit the disabled collector contract, minimal field-metric versions and units, stable IDs, route-family matchers, delivery classes, metric applicability, semantic contract IDs, lifecycle state, and identity aliases only. Never emit operator labels, readiness prose, architecture references, or owner paths.

worker.rule: Emit closed collector dimension and metric validation allowlists, parent/application relationships, delivery classes, result states, and alias-to-canonical mappings.

operator.rule: Emit operator labels, ownership, architecture references, lifecycle and readiness definitions, plus complete identity history.

page-content-ready-v1.definition: The surface has meaningful primary content or an honest empty, unavailable, or error state. DOM presence and spinner removal alone are insufficient.

component-ready-v1.definition: The named component has meaningful content or an honest terminal empty, unavailable, or error state, reported by its owner.

interaction-settled-v1.definition: The named action has produced visible feedback and reached its owner-defined terminal result; feedback and settled timestamps remain distinct.
